scientific_design.dimension_alignment: official overlapping-vocabulary embedding LAP with absolute-cosine cost and sign correction
scientific_design.layer_alignment: official LAP when layer counts differ; identity order when equal
scientific_design.primary_score: arithmetic mean of Wq and Wk CKA over all official matched layer pairs

calibration.negative_distribution: three frozen family-diverse unrelated models, one score per model
calibration.threshold_rule: tau = maximum score among the three frozen unrelated negatives
calibration.tie_rule: score equal to tau is negative
calibration.rationale: pre-registered empirical family-wise separation boundary; no arbitrary numerical constant and no post-result tuning
